related_questions.question: What is the best way to pay your Council Tax?
related_questions.snippet: By Direct Debit Direct Debit is the easiest way to pay your Council Tax. Pick a payment date that suits you (1, 14, 21 or 28 of the month) and your payment is automatically debited from your account each month. You can also set up a Direct Debit through your online Council Tax account.

related_questions.question: When should I pay Council Tax in the UK?
related_questions.snippet: Council Tax instalments are due by the 1st of each month. You can pay your bill in 10 or 12 monthly instalments or you can also choose to pay it fortnightly. You will be in arrears if you pay after these dates. You can also change your instalment date to the 9th or the 25th of the month.
